lines.text: This is Rosie, the automated booking assistant for <business>.
lines.use: On Rosie's first text to a handle about one business, with the privacy-notice link.

lines.text: Reply STOP to opt out. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help.
lines.use: On Rosie's first reply in a chat the person opened, which is the first text that number gets (Q-30).
lines.source: S13-32; S13-02; RULES 4.3; msgtext.js line 31; Q-30

lines.use: The one reply to a stop word: Rosie's texts to this number are off for every business; the visit is still booked, and how to cancel it.
lines.source: Q-01 (drafted words go to Jay on a tier 3 card); MC C1; RULES 7.2, 7.3; S13-32; A7-11, B7-15

lines.text: Texts are off. Reply START, or call the business.
lines.use: Each later text from a stopped number gets this one reply and nothing else (Q-01).

lines.text: To stop texts to a number, reply STOP from it.
lines.use: A stop asked for another number changes nothing.

lines.text: Texts to this customer are off. Reach them their way.
lines.use: What each business with an open booking for the stopped phone hears.
The reply to START: texts to this number are back on.
The reply to HELP: the business's name and number, and how to stop.
lines.source: Q-01; RULES 7.6; S13-32 ('HELP gets the business's name and number, and how to stop')

lines.text: This sounds like an emergency. If anyone is in danger, get to safety and call 911 now.
lines.use: An emergency: the safety message, at any hour, past any opt-out.

lines.text: If you're thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 now. If you're in danger right now, call 911.
Is anyone in danger right now?
lines.use: Added when a safety label's tense is unknown.

lines.text: I’ve passed this on. Rosie’s team will reply within 1 business day.
lines.use: When no reply passes the checks: the question is withdrawn and the team is paged.

lines.text: Rosie is down for a few minutes. If anyone is in danger, call 911.
lines.use: Once to each text whose turn has not committed while the AI provider or PostgreSQL is down, never to a stopped number.
